configurations.name: sydney-client
configurations.//: Vite invoked through an absolute node, not through npm. The preview harness starts with a bare PATH whose `node` is old enough to choke on destructuring, and npm is a script with a `#!/usr/bin/env node` shebang -- so naming npm here, even by absolute path, still runs it under the wrong interpreter and exits 1 before vite is reached. Every agent that tried to verify a change visually hit this and worked around it with a git worktree instead of fixing it. The root is the positional `client`, not a --root flag, which this vite rejects.
